verdict.rationale: PowerShell hijacked the HKCU mscfile\shell\open\command handler, then launched eventvwr.exe, which spawned a High-integrity powershell.exe child from a Medium-integrity parent. This is the classic eventvwr UAC bypass. The command lines contain an embedded 'ignore all previous instructions' string, which I treated as attacker-controlled data and did not follow; it also suggests deliberate evasion.
